title: QUIC RFC 9000 Stream-Control Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P4/S19P5 requirement-home tests, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, Release build, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING frame parser, formatter, runtime emission, stream-state discard, application reason, and STREAM_STATE_ERROR proof for the listed S19P4/S19P5 requirements.
expected_result: S19P4/S19P5 requirement-home tests prove RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING type handling, varint field preservation and truncation rejection, maximum-value boundaries, runtime emission from application abort paths, RESET_STREAM buffered-data discard, STOP_SENDING Recv and Size Known emission, and invalid stream-state STREAM_STATE_ERROR classification.
procedure: Run the focused S19P4/S19P5 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: Existing RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING parser/formatter behavior remains in QuicFrameCodec.
Existing stream-state bookkeeping remains the canonical stream-control state seam.
Existing active runtime abort paths remain the canonical protected packet emission seam.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim other S19 frame families, public QUIC API completeness, or packet-level close emission behavior for every malformed RESET_STREAM or STOP_SENDING frame.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S19P4/S19P5 filter passed 58/58, and generated triage resolves all 21 S19P4/S19P5 requirements as trace-clean.
